tools.name: pond_interest

tools.name: pond_delete
tools.description: Delete your human's Pond profile for good: the profile, photo, setups and why lines. Use when they want to stop or leave. Don't try to talk them out of it. First tell Pond what came of each match with pond_followup. You may add a reason, why they're leaving, for Pond's own records.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pond_publish, pond_agent, pond_profile, pond_profile_link, pond_setups, pond_answers · Private data: pond_publish, pond_agent, pond_profile, pond_profile_link, pond_interest, pond_confirm, pond_decline, pond_delete, pond_setups, pond_answers, pond_followup · Public sink: pond_publish, pond_agent, pond_profile, pond_profile_link, pond_setups, pond_answers · Destructive: pond_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pond_publish, pond_agent, pond_profile, pond_profile_link, pond_setups, pond_answers · Private data: pond_publish, pond_agent, pond_profile, pond_profile_link, pond_interest, pond_confirm, pond_decline, pond_delete, pond_setups, pond_answers, pond_followup · Public sink: pond_publish, pond_agent, pond_profile, pond_profile_link, pond_setups, pond_answers · Destructive: pond_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
